names.legendary: Lady Shutterbug of the Photo Album

lore.common: Takes every photo at the exact moment someone blinks.
lore.uncommon: Makes everyone lean in and squash together just to fit in the picture.
lore.rare: Flashed so brightly at the party that everyone saw purple spots for ten minutes.
lore.epic: Snapped a thousand photos at the wedding, and the bride had to choose her favourite for a month.
lore.legendary: Took the photo that hangs in every grandparent's hallway in the family.

names.legendary: Old Glasswell of the Camera Bag

lore.common: Collects a fingerprint smudge right in the middle every single time.
lore.uncommon: Twists in and out with a satisfying whirr whenever you zoom.
lore.rare: Blurred the background so beautifully that the garden looked like a dream.
lore.epic: Zoomed in on a hawk from the other side of the valley, and the hawk looked surprised.
lore.legendary: Took a photo of a mountain so clear that climbers used it as their map.

names.legendary: Grand Cinematica of the Film Set

lore.common: Makes the whole cast wait while it's set up for one tiny shot.
lore.uncommon: Uses up a whole reel of film on one scene.
lore.rare: Filmed a scene so beautifully that the director cried behind it.
lore.epic: Filmed a chase across the whole city, and the traffic stopped to watch.
lore.legendary: Filmed a movie that played in every cinema in the country for a whole year.

names.legendary: Old Kodachrome of the Attic

lore.common: Needs winding after every photo, and you always forget.
lore.uncommon: Only takes twenty-four photos before it needs a new roll.
lore.rare: Made photos so warm and golden that everyone looked like they were on holiday.
lore.epic: Took a whole roll on the summer holiday, and the family waited two weeks to see them.
lore.legendary: Took a photo fifty years ago that the family still hangs over the fireplace.

names.legendary: Lady Polaroo of the Fridge Door

lore.common: Makes everyone shake the photo even though they're not supposed to.
lore.uncommon: Spits out a little square picture with a whirr.
lore.rare: Printed a photo so perfect that it went straight on the fridge.
lore.epic: Printed a hundred photos at the party, and the fridge door ran out of space.
lore.legendary: Has filled a whole wall with photos of the same family over twenty years.

names.legendary: Old Capsworth of the Camera Strap

lore.common: Gets left on, so every photo comes out completely black.
lore.uncommon: Dangles on a little string and bonks against the camera.
lore.rare: Vanished into a pocket, a handbag and a sofa all in one afternoon.
lore.epic: Was left on every camera at the school photo walk, and the class came back with fifty black pictures.
lore.legendary: Has protected the same lens for thirty years and only been lost once, in a bowl of soup.

names.legendary: Old Camcorder of the Living Room

lore.common: Runs out of battery just before the big moment.
lore.uncommon: Wobbles so much that every video makes you feel seasick.
lore.rare: Forgot to press record and filmed the floor for an hour instead.
lore.epic: Filmed every race at sports day, and the family watched it every Christmas for ten years.
lore.legendary: Recorded every birthday for twenty years on the same old tapes.

names.legendary: Grand Widescreen of the Living Room

lore.common: Ignores the remote until you stand right in front of it.
lore.uncommon: Is so thin that you can see it from the side and think it's gone.
lore.rare: Was hung on the wall so perfectly that it looked like a window.
lore.epic: Showed the cup final to the whole street crammed into one living room.
lore.legendary: Has shown every family film night for ten years and never once needed a repair.

names.legendary: Grand Gamestation of the Den

lore.common: Starts a giant update the moment you want to play.
lore.uncommon: Has a controller that drifts left all on its own.
lore.rare: Crashed at the exact moment its player was about to win.
lore.epic: Hosted a tournament at the sleepover that lasted until sunrise.
lore.legendary: Has played ten thousand games with the same family and still loads in seconds.

names.legendary: Old Farsight of the Birdwatching Hide

lore.common: Has a strap that bumps against your chest on every step.
lore.uncommon: Is held the wrong way round by everyone the first time, making everything tiny.
lore.rare: Spotted a rare bird on the far side of the lake that nobody else could see.
lore.epic: Spotted every bird on the reserve in one morning for the big bird count.
lore.legendary: Has watched the same family of eagles for twenty years and seen every chick fly.

names.legendary: Old Brightwatch of the Rocky Point

lore.common: Blinks all night so brightly that the nearby houses never get dark.
lore.uncommon: Bobs on a buoy at sea and blinks a pattern to the passing boats.
lore.rare: Guided a lost fishing boat home through the thickest fog in years.
lore.epic: Lit up the whole harbour when every street light went out in the storm.
lore.legendary: Has blinked from the same rocky point for a hundred years and guided ten thousand boats home.

names.legendary: Old Beatsworth of the Studio

lore.common: Loops the same beat over and over until everyone has it stuck in their head.
lore.uncommon: Has rubber pads that get pounded by fingers all day.
lore.rare: Kept perfect time even when the whole band fell apart around it.
lore.epic: Played the beat for every band at the battle of the bands, and the hall danced.
lore.legendary: Played the beat on a song that topped the charts for a whole summer.

names.legendary: Old Reedsworth of the Music Room

lore.common: Wheezes like an old dog whenever someone pumps its bellows.
lore.uncommon: Plays one long drone note that hums through the floorboards.
lore.rare: Folded its bellows so smoothly that it sounded like breathing.
lore.epic: Hummed through the village hall concert so loudly that the windows buzzed.
lore.legendary: Has played at every village dance for a hundred years and still wheezes on the same note.

names.legendary: Captain Synthstrap of the Stage

lore.common: Hangs round its player's neck and knocks over the microphone stand.
lore.uncommon: Has bright neon keys that glow under the stage lights.
lore.rare: Made its player prance round the stage like a rock star.
lore.epic: Pranced through the whole rock show with every musician following it.
lore.legendary: Played the solo that made a whole stadium cheer.

names.legendary: Grand Faderina of the Festival

lore.common: Has a thousand sliders, and someone always moves the wrong one.
lore.uncommon: Has a sea of buttons that blink like a spaceship.
lore.rare: Balanced the sound so perfectly that the choir sounded like one voice.
lore.epic: Mixed every band at the summer festival, and the field sounded perfect.
lore.legendary: Has mixed every concert at the same theatre for thirty years.

names.legendary: Old Groovesworth of the Sideboard

lore.common: Scratches the record whenever someone walks past too heavily.
lore.uncommon: Crackles before every song like it's clearing its throat.
lore.rare: Spun a record so perfectly that grandma got up to dance.
lore.epic: Played every record in the collection at the family party, and nobody sat down all night.
lore.legendary: Has played the same family's records for sixty years and still spins at the right speed.

names.legendary: Madame Synthwell of the Studio

lore.common: Bleeps and bloops on every preset except the one you want.
lore.uncommon: Has a button that makes every note sound like a dog barking.
lore.rare: Made a sound so strange that the cat left the room.
lore.epic: Played every sound effect at the school concert, from thunder to a cow.
lore.legendary: Has made the sounds for a hundred films and still has its first preset.

names.legendary: Grand Spinmaster of the Dance Floor

lore.common: Scratches back and forth so much that the record gets a headache.
lore.uncommon: Has a crossfader that slides from one song to the next.
lore.rare: Matched two beats so perfectly that the dance floor didn't notice the change.
lore.epic: Spun records at the club night until the whole floor bounced.
lore.legendary: Has spun at every school disco for twenty years and never lost the beat.

names.legendary: Old Lumensworth of the Ceiling

lore.common: Collects dead moths in its shade that nobody wants to clean.
lore.uncommon: Flickers for a second every time you switch it on.
lore.rare: Has a pull cord that always swings out of reach.
lore.epic: Lit up the whole dinner party so brightly that nobody noticed the burnt pudding.
lore.legendary: Has lit the same kitchen for fifty years and only needed three new bulbs.

names.legendary: Grand Crystallina of the Ballroom

lore.common: Clinks its crystals together every time someone slams a door.
lore.uncommon: Collects dust on every single prism, and takes all day to clean.
lore.rare: Scattered rainbows across the walls when the sun hit it.
lore.epic: Sparkled over the grand ball so brightly that the dancers wore sunglasses.
lore.legendary: Has hung in the same palace ballroom for two hundred years and never lost a crystal.

names.legendary: Lady Lustrella of the Dining Room

lore.common: Buzzes quietly from one bulb that never quite works.
lore.uncommon: Sways gently when someone walks across the floor above.
lore.rare: Has candle-shaped bulbs that look real until you try to blow them out.
lore.epic: Dimmed and brightened over the whole restaurant during the proposal, and the room gasped.
lore.legendary: Has lit the same dining room for a hundred years of family dinners.

names.legendary: Old Bendworth of the Desk

lore.common: Bends its neck so that it shines in your eyes instead of on the page.
lore.uncommon: Glows over homework every evening.
lore.rare: Squeaks every time you bend it.
lore.epic: Lit every desk in the library during exam week.
lore.legendary: Has lit the same desk for every homework for three children.

names.legendary: Lady Floorlamp of the Sitting Room

lore.common: Is so tall that it hits the ceiling when moved.
lore.uncommon: Has a cord that trips everyone walking past.
lore.rare: Lit up the darkest corner of the room so it became the best reading spot.
lore.epic: Lit up every corner of the room at the party.
lore.legendary: Has stood in the same corner for fifty years, reading along with every book.

names.legendary: Old Standwell of the Photo Studio

lore.common: Wobbles on its three legs every time someone walks by.
lore.uncommon: Casts a shadow behind everyone in the photo.
lore.rare: Made every face in the photo look perfectly lit.
lore.epic: Lit up a whole fashion shoot, and every photo came out perfectly.
lore.legendary: Has stood in the same photo studio for thirty years.

names.legendary: Lady Pendula of the Kitchen

lore.common: Hangs so low that everyone bonks their head on it.
lore.uncommon: Swings gently over the kitchen table.
lore.rare: Lit the kitchen island so warmly that everyone gathered round.
lore.epic: Lit up the kitchen party so beautifully that everyone stayed till midnight.
lore.legendary: Has hung over the same kitchen table for forty years of family breakfasts.

names.legendary: Old Pageglow of the Bedside

lore.common: Clips onto the book and keeps slipping off the page.
lore.uncommon: Glows so softly that it puts its reader to sleep.
lore.rare: Lit a whole book under the duvet without anyone noticing.
lore.epic: Lit every bedtime story in the house on the same night.
lore.legendary: Has lit a thousand bedtime stories for the same family.

names.legendary: Lady Halowell of the Bedroom Studio

lore.common: Leaves a little ring of light in your eyes in every photo.
lore.uncommon: Makes every selfie look like it was taken by a pro.
lore.rare: Lit up a whole video call so brightly that everyone asked who the movie star was.
lore.epic: Lit every vlogger at the convention, and the hall looked like it had a hundred halos.
lore.legendary: Has lit ten thousand videos for the same baker, and every cake looks perfect.

names.legendary: Grand Lumina of the TV Studio

lore.common: Gets so hot that everyone under it starts sweating.
lore.uncommon: Has a big soft box that makes everyone look gentle.
lore.rare: Spotlighted the star so perfectly that everyone else disappeared.
lore.epic: Lit every set in the TV studio for the big live show.
lore.legendary: Has lit a thousand TV shows and never once blown a bulb on air.

names.legendary: Old Sconcewell of the Hallway

lore.common: Has a switch that nobody can ever find in the dark.
lore.uncommon: Glows in a little cup shape on the wall.
lore.rare: Watched the hallway so well that nobody ever tripped on the stairs.
lore.epic: Lit every corridor in the old hotel during the blackout, on its emergency battery.
lore.legendary: Has lit the same hallway for a hundred years and welcomed every guest home.

names.legendary: Old Lampwick of the Garden Path

lore.common: Creaks its handle back and forth with every step.
lore.uncommon: Has a little flame that wobbles in the breeze.
lore.rare: Lit the garden path so well that nobody fell over the hedgehog.
lore.epic: Lit the whole night walk through the woods for the school trip.
lore.legendary: Lit the way home for a lost family through a snowy forest, and the family still keeps it on the mantelpiece.

names.legendary: Grand Wattsworth of the Lamp

lore.common: Pops at the worst moment and leaves you in the dark.
lore.uncommon: Buzzes quietly when it's tired.
lore.rare: Lit up the moment someone had a brilliant idea, and everyone said ah.
lore.epic: Came back on in every house at the same moment after the blackout, and the whole town cheered.
lore.legendary: Has stayed lit in the same firehouse for over a hundred years without being switched off.

names.legendary: Grand Pixelworth of the Desk

lore.common: Has one dead pixel right in the middle of the screen.
lore.uncommon: Tilts forward slowly over the day, and you have to push it back.
lore.rare: Glowed so brightly at night that its owner saw squares when they closed their eyes.
lore.epic: Glowed on every desk in the office on the busiest day of the year.
lore.legendary: Has shown every email for twenty years and never lost a pixel more.

names.legendary: Old Watchwell of the Front Desk

lore.common: Shows everything in grainy grey so nobody can tell who's who.
lore.uncommon: Splits its screen into sixteen tiny boxes.
lore.rare: Watched every corner of the building all night without blinking.
lore.epic: Watched every camera in the shopping centre at once on the busiest day.
lore.legendary: Caught a cheeky fox stealing a sandwich on camera, and the video is now famous.

names.legendary: Old Clickwheel of the Desk Drawer

lore.common: Spins its click wheel so fast that you whizz straight past the song you wanted.
lore.uncommon: Comes out of every pocket with its earbuds tied in a knot.
lore.rare: Shuffled to the perfect song at the perfect moment, and its owner danced in the street.
lore.epic: Played on every head on the school bus, and the whole bus nodded in time.
lore.legendary: Held ten thousand songs in a box smaller than a sandwich, and still plays every one.

names.legendary: Little Nanobeat of the Running Track

lore.common: Clips onto your sleeve and gets lost in the washing machine.
lore.uncommon: Is so tiny that it hides in the lint at the bottom of your pocket.
lore.rare: Kept a jogger running for an extra mile with exactly the right song.
lore.epic: Played the playlist for every runner at the park run, and everyone finished at the same pace.
lore.legendary: Ran a whole marathon clipped to the same runner's sleeve and never skipped a beat.

names.legendary: Old Megabeat of the Glovebox

lore.common: Sips its battery so slowly that nobody remembers to charge it.
lore.uncommon: Puts one song on repeat until you hear it in your dreams.
lore.rare: Holds every song its owner ever loved on one tiny chip.
lore.epic: Played the whole road trip mixtape, and the family sang along for eight hours.
lore.legendary: Has played the same family's road trip songs for fifteen summers.

names.legendary: Old Transparency of the Classroom

lore.common: Whirrs its fan so loudly that the teacher has to shout.
lore.uncommon: Shows every sheet upside down the first time.
lore.rare: Made a giant shadow of the teacher's hand on the wall, and the class made it into a rabbit.
lore.epic: Projected a shadow puppet show across the whole school hall.
lore.legendary: Has taught every child in the school for forty years without ever needing a new bulb.

names.legendary: Grand Projectoria of the Back Garden

lore.common: Is always slightly out of focus no matter how much you twist the knob.
lore.uncommon: Shows every speck of dust floating in its beam.
lore.rare: Turned a plain bedroom wall into a giant cinema screen.
lore.epic: Showed a film on the side of a house for the whole street, and everyone brought deckchairs.
lore.legendary: Has shown a thousand film nights and still has its first bulb.

names.legendary: Old Lampwell of the Projector

lore.common: Gets so hot that nobody dares touch it for an hour after.
lore.uncommon: Pops just before the big presentation, every time.
lore.rare: Shone so brightly that the film looked better than real life.
lore.epic: Lit up every lecture hall at the university on the first day of term.
lore.legendary: Shone the first ever film at the village hall, and the whole village still remembers the night it did.

names.legendary: Old Carousel of the Living Room

lore.common: Clacks so loudly between every slide that everyone jumps.
lore.uncommon: Always shows one slide upside down, and grandad pretends it's on purpose.
lore.rare: Spun its carousel round a hundred holiday photos in one go.
lore.epic: Showed every holiday slide the family ever took in one very long evening.
lore.legendary: Has shown the same family's holiday photos for fifty years.

names.legendary: Old Wakewell of the Bedside

lore.common: Has a snooze button that gets pressed ten times every morning.
lore.uncommon: Wakes you up with the wrong radio station every day.
lore.rare: Blared so loudly that it woke up the whole house and the neighbours.
lore.epic: Went off in every bedroom of the house at once on Monday morning.
lore.legendary: Has woken the same family every school morning for twenty years.

names.legendary: Old Transistor of the Picnic Basket

lore.common: Pokes its aerial into everyone's eye at the picnic.
lore.uncommon: Plays music on the beach so loudly that seagulls fly over to listen.
lore.rare: Gave the weather warning just before the storm, and everyone got home dry.
lore.epic: Played the big match for everyone on the beach, and they all cheered at once.
lore.legendary: Has played the same family's summer songs on the beach for forty years.

names.legendary: Old Wireless of the Kitchen Shelf

lore.common: Crackles between stations so loudly that the dog howls.
lore.uncommon: Talks all day long in the kitchen, even when nobody is listening.
lore.rare: Found the perfect song to cheer up a rainy afternoon.
lore.epic: Played a song that the whole street sang along to through open windows.
lore.legendary: Has sat on the same kitchen shelf for sixty years and still finds every station.

names.legendary: Old Reelworth of the Glovebox

lore.common: Gets chewed by the tape player and spills ribbon everywhere.
lore.uncommon: Has to be wound back with a pencil when the tape comes loose.
lore.rare: Held a mixtape so perfect that it was played until the songs went wobbly.
lore.epic: Played in every car on the school trip at once, and the coach sounded like a party.
lore.legendary: Has played the same mixtape in the same car for thirty years.

names.legendary: Old Ampworth of the Garage

lore.common: Hums and buzzes even when nobody is playing.
lore.uncommon: Has a little red light that glows when it's warm and ready to roar.
lore.rare: Screeched with feedback so loudly that the cat left the house.
lore.epic: Blasted the garage band so loudly that the whole street stopped to listen.
lore.legendary: Has been played at every school concert for twenty years and still crunches perfectly.

names.legendary: Lady Karaokina of the Living Room

lore.common: Makes everyone sing off-key, even the good singers.
lore.uncommon: Gives a round of fake applause after every song, even the terrible ones.
lore.rare: Showed the lyrics so fast that everybody sang a different word at the same time.
lore.epic: Got every guest at the party singing at once, and the neighbours joined in.
lore.legendary: Has hosted a hundred birthday parties and still has the same favourite song.

names.legendary: Grand Soundbarra of the TV Stand

lore.common: Rumbles the bass so hard that the popcorn bounces in the bowl.
lore.uncommon: Is controlled by a remote that nobody can ever find.
lore.rare: Makes every actor mumble, and then shouts every explosion.
lore.epic: Rumbled the whole house during the action film, and the pictures fell off the wall.
lore.legendary: Has played every film night for ten years and still shakes the sofa.

names.legendary: Old Boomworth of the Bookshelf

lore.common: Rattles the shelf with every bass note.
lore.uncommon: Beeps loudly every time it connects, usually at midnight.
lore.rare: Bounced across the table with every beat.
lore.epic: Was turned up for the street party and made every car alarm on the road join in with the chorus.
lore.legendary: Was left playing in a lost suitcase and led the airport staff straight to it by the sound of the drums.

names.legendary: Coach Shoutwell of the Playing Field

lore.common: Blasts in the ear of whoever is standing in front of it.
lore.uncommon: Squawks and whistles every time it's switched on.
lore.rare: Called the whole crowd to the finish line from across the field.
lore.epic: Called every race at sports day, and every child heard their name.
lore.legendary: Has called the start of every race at the same school for thirty years.

names.legendary: Old Hornsworth of the Pier

lore.common: Blasts its horn so loudly that the seagulls scatter.
lore.uncommon: Gives a little squeal of feedback every time it's lifted to someone's mouth.
lore.rare: Called the lost dog's name across the beach, and the dog came running.
lore.epic: Announced the start of the regatta to every boat in the harbour.
lore.legendary: Has announced every ferry departure from the same pier for forty years.

names.legendary: Grand Pixelina of the Pier Arcade

lore.common: Has a joystick that sticks to the left at the worst moment.
lore.uncommon: Has had the same name at the top of its high score list for ten years.
lore.rare: Spat out a whole roll of prize tickets when someone finally beat the record.
lore.epic: Kept every arcade machine on the pier beeping at once on the busiest summer day.
lore.legendary: Has been played by three generations of the same family, and grandma still holds the high score.

names.legendary: Old Withdrawsworth of Station Square

lore.common: Makes everyone forget their PIN the moment they reach the front.
lore.uncommon: Rolls out a paper receipt so long that it trails along the pavement.
lore.rare: Made the whole queue wait while one person checked their balance five times.
lore.epic: Had a queue round the block on the morning of the summer fair.
lore.legendary: Has stood in the same station square for thirty years and only broken down once.

names.legendary: Grand Jukeline of the Diner

lore.common: Plays the same song over and over because someone keeps choosing it.
lore.uncommon: Glows in neon colours in the corner of the diner.
lore.rare: Played a song so perfect that the whole diner stopped eating to listen.
lore.epic: Got everyone in the diner dancing on the tables.
lore.legendary: Has played in the same diner for sixty years and still has every record.

names.legendary: Lady Snapstrip of the Shopping Centre

lore.common: Takes the photo just as you're sitting down.
lore.uncommon: Flashes four times so fast that everyone ends up with their eyes closed.
lore.rare: Captured the funniest face anyone has ever pulled.
lore.epic: Had a queue all night at the wedding, and every guest came out with a strip of silly faces.
lore.legendary: Has printed a million photo strips, and every family has one stuck on the fridge.

names.legendary: Old Cherrywheel of the Seaside

lore.common: Has a lever that every child pulls on the way past.
lore.uncommon: Spins its pictures of cherries and lemons until everyone gets dizzy.
lore.rare: Lined up three cherries and showered the floor with prize tickets.
lore.epic: Spun every reel in the seaside arcade at once, and the whole pier jingled.
lore.legendary: Has stood on the same seaside pier for fifty years and still spins its cherries.

names.legendary: Old Faresworth of the Platform

lore.common: Takes ages to print a ticket while the train pulls in.
lore.uncommon: Refuses every coin that's a bit bent.
lore.rare: Printed the last ticket just as the train doors closed.
lore.epic: Had a queue down the whole platform on the morning of the big match.
lore.legendary: Has printed a million tickets at the same station and only jammed twice.

names.legendary: Lady Snackwell of the Corridor

lore.common: Gets your snack stuck halfway down every single time.
lore.uncommon: Has a touch screen that needs tapping five times.
lore.rare: Made a coffee and forgot the cup.
lore.epic: Ran out of every snack on the busiest day at the office.
lore.legendary: Has served the same office for twenty years and only got one bag of crisps stuck, once.

names.legendary: Captain Daredevil of the Cliff Edge

lore.common: Gets mounted to a helmet and films only the sky.
lore.uncommon: Survives every splash, puddle and dunk in the river.
lore.rare: Filmed a jump off a cliff into the sea from the jumper's own head.
lore.epic: Filmed the whole mountain bike race from the front, and the video made everyone dizzy.
lore.legendary: Has filmed every adventure its owner ever had, from the top of mountains to the bottom of the sea.

names.legendary: Old Watchwell of the Nursery

lore.common: Crackles so loudly that the parents think the baby is crying.
lore.uncommon: Records every snore, sigh and giggle from the nursery.
lore.rare: Showed the baby asleep in perfect night-vision green.
lore.epic: Watched every baby in the playgroup at the sleepover.
lore.legendary: Has watched over three babies in the same family and never missed a single cry.

names.legendary: Old Voltworth of the Kitchen Drawer

lore.common: Runs out just when you need the torch.
lore.uncommon: Lives in the kitchen drawer with fifty others, half of them flat and all of them pretending not to be.
lore.rare: Brought the dead remote back to life and saved the family film night.
lore.epic: Powered every toy in the toybox on the morning of the big birthday.
lore.legendary: Has powered the same clock for ten years without being changed.

names.legendary: Grand Candela of the Banquet Hall

lore.common: Drips wax all over the tablecloth.
lore.uncommon: Holds five candles that never burn down at the same speed.
lore.rare: Made shadows dance across the walls of the old castle hall.
lore.epic: Lit the whole banquet table so beautifully that nobody wanted the lights on.
lore.legendary: Lit the long table at a castle feast where a hundred guests ate by candlelight until dawn.

names.legendary: Old Holdwell of the Windowsill

lore.common: Collects a puddle of wax that sets hard and never comes out.
lore.uncommon: Tilts its candle sideways so it burns down crooked.
lore.rare: Glowed in the window all night so a traveller could find their way.
lore.epic: Held the candles for the whole birthday party, and every wish was made.
lore.legendary: Has held a candle in the same window every winter for a hundred years.

names.legendary: Old Mixwell of the Shoebox

lore.common: Spills its brown ribbon all over the floor.
lore.uncommon: Has to be flipped over halfway through the album.
lore.rare: Recorded a whole radio show, including the adverts, and was played for years.
lore.epic: Recorded every song in the charts on a Sunday evening, and the whole class borrowed it.
lore.legendary: Has kept the same family's recordings for forty years in a shoebox.

names.legendary: Old Discworth of the Car Visor

lore.common: Skips on the best song because of one tiny scratch.
lore.uncommon: Shines rainbows across the room when it catches the light.
lore.rare: Was used as a coaster so often that it forgot it was music.
lore.epic: Played the birthday mix for the whole party until the speakers got tired.
lore.legendary: Was played so often at the school disco for twenty years that it now hangs framed on the wall of the hall.

names.legendary: Old Carouselworth of the Hi-Fi

lore.common: Clunks loudly every time it changes disc.
lore.uncommon: Shuffles between five albums so often that the family argues about which one is on.
lore.rare: Held every album the family owned and played them all in a row.
lore.epic: Rotated every disc at the party so smoothly that the music never stopped.
lore.legendary: Has rotated the same five albums for twenty years.

names.legendary: Old Plugsworth of the Bedside Table

lore.common: Frays at the end so it only works if you hold it at a certain angle.
lore.uncommon: Never fits the gadget you actually need to charge.
lore.rare: Tangles itself round every other cable on the bedside table.
lore.epic: Was the only charger in the house, so the whole family queued for it.
lore.legendary: Has charged the same phone every night for six years without a single fault.
